trello.name: Benchmark PgBouncer transaction mode for dashboard connection contention
trello.desc: Raj to investigate dashboard slowness for accounts with many projects caused by database connection contention, not query cost. Set up a load test that mirrors the dashboard's query pattern. Benchmark p95 latency with current connection setup vs PgBouncer in transaction mode. Bring quantitative results to next sync. Acceptance criteria: load test reproduces dashboard workload, p95 latency measured for both configurations, results documented with methodology and numbers for review.

trello.name: Fix typo in onboarding email subject line
trello.desc: Marketing identified typo 'recieve' in onboarding email subject line. Tom to correct spelling to 'receive' in the email template repository today and submit for re-approval. Acceptance criteria: typo corrected in template repo, change reviewed and approved, fix deployed so new onboarding emails send with correct subject.

trello.name: Update roadmap doc to move dark mode under design-system upgrade
trello.desc: Roadmap doc currently lists dark mode under 'Q3 committed' which is now inaccurate. Tom to update the roadmap document to remove dark mode as a standalone Q3 commitment and place it under the September design-system upgrade line item. Acceptance criteria: roadmap reflects that dark mode is included via the September design-system upgrade theming, no longer promised as standalone, and sales reference is corrected.

trello.name: Document decision to remain on Postgres and close MongoDB evaluation
trello.desc: Team decided to stay on Postgres, no migration and no evaluation task for MongoDB. Record the decision and ensure no MongoDB migration work is on the board. Acceptance criteria: decision logged in meeting notes/decision log, any existing MongoDB evaluation tickets closed as wont-do, and team informed that Postgres is the approved database with connection pooling as the remediation path.
